Message.Name: Series Update
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Option series traded on Pearl for the current session on the cloud associated for this connection

Field.Name: Product Add/Update Time
Field.Description: Time at which this product is added/updated on Pearl system today

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Pearl Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price of the option

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 09:30:00

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 16:15:00

Field.Name: Restricted Option
Field.Description: Restricted option

Field.Name: Long Term Option
Field.Description: Long term option

Field.Name: Active on Pearl
Field.Description: Indicates if this symbol is tradable on Pearl in the current session

Field.Name: Pearl BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by Pearl

Field.Name: Order Acceptance Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation for Order acceptance as per Pearl rules

Field.Name: Opening Underlying Market Code
Field.Description: Options opening will be triggered on receipt of Opening quote/trade from this Underlying market

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: ARM Settings Update Request
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to set up their ARM protection settings for each session. Changes to these settings can be made throughout the day

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Pearl assigned ID of the Member

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Action

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol for which this ARM protection is applicable. Optional: If this is filled with spaces, this ARM protection setting will be used as a default setting for this MPID

Field.Name: Allowable Engagement Percentage
Field.Description: Percentage of order size at which the Member wants Pearl to trigger ARM protection for this underlying. Minimum value is 1 (1%). Maximum is 65,535 (65,535%)

Field.Name: Counting Period
Field.Description: Duration (in number of milliseconds) in which Engagement percentage is calculated in order to determine if the MPID should be put on ARM protection for this underlying. Allowable Range: 100 to 15,000 milliseconds

Message.Name: ARM Settings Update Response
Message.Description: Pearl uses this format to respond to the firm with a status of their ARM protection settings request

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Pearl assigned ID of the Member

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying sent in the request. Firms can use this to know which underlying setting did not take into effect in case of an error

Field.Name: ARM Settings Update Status
Field.Description: ARM settings update status

Message.Name: ARM2 Underlying Level Protection Settings Update Request
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to set up their ARM2 Underlying Level protection settings for each session. Changes to these settings can be made throughout the day

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Pearl assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Action

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol for which this ARM2 protection is applicable

Field.Name: ARM Threshold Count
Field.Description: Number of ARM triggers for the Counting Period for the specified underlying that will trigger ARM2 Underlying level protection. Minimum: 3 Maximum: 99

Field.Name: Counting Period
Field.Description: Duration (in number of milliseconds) for which ARM triggers are counted in order to determine if they don't exceed the specified ARM2 Threshold. Allowable Range: 1000 to 24,300,000 milliseconds

Struct.Name: AutoReplace Order
Struct.Description: Firms can use this format to send a single AutoReplace Order in the Liquidity Unit field of the Bulk Liquidity message

Field.Name: Liquidity Unit Type
Field.Description: Liquidity unit type (A). Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client order ID. If an Order with this Client Order ID found for the same product, MPID and side, this Order replaces the resting Order. If not, this order is treated as new Order. 0 results in a reject. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Pearl assigned ID of the Member. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Product ID mapped to a given Option assigned by the Pearl for the current session. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Time In Force (TIF)
Field.Description: Time in force. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Order Instruction
Field.Description: Order instruction. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Origin
Field.Description: Specifies the order origin type. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: MVP
Field.Description: Number or price levels up to which the order will trade from the initial market price at time of arrival. Negative value indicates MEO to use Exchange default value. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: 0 for market orders. Max Price is defined in Regulatory Circulars. Market orders are not allowed for Origin 4(MM) and 5(Away MM). Replaceable: Y

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of contracts. Max size: 999999. Replaceable: Y

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Open/Close
Field.Description: Open or close. Replaceable: Y

Field.Name: Covered/Uncovered
Field.Description: Covered or uncovered. Replaceable: Y

Field.Name: Clearing Account
Field.Description: OCC Sub account (Multi-account) for non-MM (origin not equal to 4) orders. Must be filled for Away MM (origin equal to 5). Must be filled with MM MPID for EEMs sending MM orders in which case MPID field above becomes Executing MPID. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: CMTA
Field.Description: Maximum value 99999. 0 = CMTA not specified. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer ID defined by the firms. This will be passed through for clearing. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Additional Text
Field.Description: Additional text that can hold billing, clearing or pertinent information that firms need. This will be passed through for clearing. Replaceable: N
